raw_text: Stack: Spring Boot 4, WebFlux, Kotlin Coroutines, jOOQ, R2DBC, PostgreSQL. `*Router.kt`: `coRouter { }` routes/error handlers; `*Handler.kt`: suspended handlers delegate to service; `*Service.kt`: business logic, `<REDACTED_USER>` annotations, `NotFoundException`; `*Repository.kt`: jOOQ DSL, `Flow<T>`/`suspend`, `asFlow()`, `awaitFirst/awaitFirstOrNull`. All HTTP handlers are `suspend` functions using coroutines. Service-layer `<REDACTED_USER>` works via R2DBC connection factory proxy. OpenAPI-generate external contracts; put in contract subproject resources; client/models in contract owner base package. Always run `./gradlew clean test` on root after contract changes. Map via extensions. Don't try to replace something by default values on errors. If you received something unexpected, log and rethrow IllegalArgumentException on incoming and IllegalStateException on outgoing. Never use optional Kotlin types for mandatory fields. Always prefer imports to fully qualified class names. Always remove unused imports and resources. Versions in `build.gradle.kts` must be root variables; keep new dependencies up to date; use jackson 3, avoid jackson 2 when possible. After changing `build.gradle.kts`, always run `./gradlew clean nativeCompile test` on that subproject. After any changes, always run `./gradlew clean test` in corresponding subproject. Consider fixing build/startup warnings. Comment non-obvious solutions or multiple approaches. Separate DB schema per subproject, defined in subproject gradle.properties, application.yml (app/test), and `<REDACTED_USER>` in AbstractContextTest. Migrations: `src/main/resources/db/migration/`; consider data migration. Run `./gradlew build` - jOOQ classes regenerate automatically. Use generated repository classes (`TEST_TABLE`, `TestTable`). Don't use database defaults; generate id/uuid/timestamp explicitly in code. Never use optional Kotlin types for non-nullable fields. Please don't use nullability without a strong reason. Tests use Zonky embedded PostgreSQL with Flyway auto-migration. Context/database tests extend AbstractContextTest. In spring context tests never use class-wide annotations on test classes. In spring context tests never use mocked beans in test classes. Instead of mocks in a spring context test, add spies to AbstractContextTest. For AbstractContextTest child tests use `<REDACTED_USER>` instead of inserts for initial state (if the test is not covering inserts) and `<REDACTED_USER>` for checks if the test is not covering reads. Separate repository/scenario dataset folders; each repository’s datasets separate. Test all layers. Never use sleep in tests. Tests: `*HandlerTest` WebTestClient HTTP; `*ServiceTest` MockK unit; `*RepositoryTest` embedded-DB integration.
